316	    function withdrawExcessInvestedCapital(
317	        uint256 amount,
318	        bytes32[] calldata proof
319	    )
320	        external
321	        virtual
322	        whenNotPaused
323	        whenSaleNotCanceled
324	    {
325	        // Get the investor position ID
326	        uint256 positionId = _getInvestorPositionId(msg.sender);
327	
328	        // Verify that the position exists
329	        _verifyPositionExists(positionId);
330	
331	        // Verify that the investor has not refunded
332	        _verifyHasNotRefunded(positionId);
333	
334	        // Verify that the investor is eligible to get excess capital back
335	        _verifyCanClaimExcessCapital(msg.sender, positionId, amount, proof);
336	
337	        // Mark that the excess capital has been returned
338	        s_investorPositions[positionId].hasClaimedExcess = true;
339	
340	        // Decrement the total invested capital for the investor
341	        s_investorPositions[positionId].investedCapital -= amount;
342	
343	        // Decrement total capital invested from all investors
344	        s_saleStatus.totalCapitalInvested -= amount;
345	
346	        // Emit ExcessCapitalWithdrawn
347	        emit ExcessCapitalWithdrawn(amount, msg.sender, positionId);
348	
349	        // Transfer the excess capital back to the investor
350	        if (amount > 0) SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer(s_addressConfig.bidToken, msg.sender, amount);
351	    }
